summary.intent: Coordinate resolving merge conflicts and outstanding code-review/slop findings across multiple open PRs, then check all open PRs for being out of sync with base or conflicting.
summary.outcome: Six parallel workers were dispatched to resolve conflicts and findings on PRs #362, #323, #324/#359, #327, #335/#345, and #367, with no results reported yet. A final check of all open PRs for sync/conflict status was started but its output is not shown.

repo: PR numbers map to 'change' numbers: change 120 is #323 (measure/storybook-accuracy-headline), change 121 is #324 (measure/layer-only-props), change 124 is #327 (feat/collapse-by-relevance).
#328 was stacked on #327 and has already merged into #327's branch, so #327 carries that work too.
CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION can be bumped by both sides of a conflict; resolution is to take the higher number plus one and hand-update the golden file because cargo insta is not available.
Repo uses changesets (.changeset/*.md) and has a full lint gate plus tests that must pass before pushing.
A classifier can deny finding dismissals; workers should report the exact command rather than work around it.
workflow: Parallel workers per PR/conflict group speed up resolution; give each explicit guidance on which side to keep where PRs overlap.
Workers should list open review and slop findings, fix or dismiss once, run full lint and tests, push without force, then wait for CI.
The coordinator should independently verify all checks by name before declaring work done.
